result.effect: 23% exact alignment; 41% UC data only; 24% CALPADS data only

cells.quote: If there was not exact alignment, then CALPADS number of units being lower than the number of units in the UC admissions dataset or data only being in the UC admissions dataset was the most common occurrence.
cells.note: The supplied study excerpt does not include the full Table 3 sentence with the G-course percentages; those percentages are reported in the wiki entry.
